title: All Genus Gopakumar-Vafa Reconstruction from Central Difference Forcing
summary: Generating functions in curve counting theory mix two different kinds of information: multiple covers mix curve degrees, while the topological string coupling mixes BPS genera. We show that a single central difference operator separates these two effects in a precise and invertible way for the all genus Gopakumar-Vafa expansion along an effective ray of a Calabi-Yau threefold.
